;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Clashes break out between [[Israel]]i security forces and [[Bedouin]] residents in [[Khan al-Ahmar (village)|Khan al-Ahmar]], [[West Bank]], as Israeli bulldozers prepare to demolish the village. The [[Supreme Court of Israel]] ruled that its residents could be evicted on May 24, while such relocation is considered illegal under [[Fourth_Geneva_Convention|international humanitarian law]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-bedouin/protests-erupt-at-bedouin-village-israel-plans-to-demolish-idUSKBN1JU1RN (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Amesbury poisonings]]
**Police determine two British nationals found unconscious at a property in [[Amesbury]], [[Wiltshire]], on Saturday were poisoned using [[Novichok]] [[nerve agent]] of the same kind used in the [[poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]] in [[Salisbury]], seven miles from Amesbury, almost four months ago. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44719639 (BBC)]
**A major incident has been declared in Amesbury and several areas of the town have been evacuated as the [[National Counter Terrorism Policing Network]] investigate the attack. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-wiltshire-44707052 (BBC)]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**[[Philippines|Philippine]] [[Philippine Army|soldiers]] clash with militants from the [[ISIL]]-affiliated [[Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters]] (BIFF), in the southern province of [[Maguindanao]]. The fighting began when BIFF militants attempted to occupy a town center, and lasted for 12 hours until the BIFF militants withdrew to the hills. Four militants were killed, while two militants, a Philippine soldier and a local militiaman were wounded. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-militants/philippine-troops-retake-town-after-12-hour-standoff-with-islamists-idUSKBN1JV06O (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Survivors trapped overnight on a stricken ferry are rescued off the [[Indonesia]]n island of [[Sulawesi]] after the ferry began sinking the day before. Out of the 139 passengers aboard, 31 have been confirmed dead, while three remain missing. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/passengers-rescued-stricken-indonesia-ferry-29-dead-56355287 (AP via ABC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[2018 Eastern Canada heat wave]]
**The death toll from a heat wave in [[Quebec]] rises to 17. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/07/04/americas/quebec-heat-deaths/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Rise and Resist]]
**At least six people are arrested for hanging a sign that read "Abolish [[U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement|ICE]]" from the base below the [[Statue of Liberty]], where no banners are permitted hung under federal law. Another is arrested after scaling the base of the statue, prompting an evacuation of [[Liberty Island|the island]] on the busy [[Independence Day (United States)|Fourth of July]] holiday. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/arrests-after-abolish-ice-sign-hung-from-statue-of-liberty/2018/07/04/827e94e8-7fc7-11e8-a63f-7b5d2aba7ac5_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/US/protester-climbs-statue-liberty-prompting-evacuation-island/story?id=56370410 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Directive on Copyright in the Digital Single Market]]
**The [[Polish Wikipedia|Polish]], [[Spanish Wikipedia|Spanish]], [[Estonian Wikipedia|Estonian]] and [[Latvian Wikipedia|Latvian]] [[List of Wikipedias|Wikipedias]] shut down in protest of the [[European Union]]'s proposed copyright reform, blocking access for all users. This follows identical actions taken by [[Italian Wikipedia]] the previous day. [https://news.err.ee/844168/estonian-wikipedia-protests-eu-plans-to-curtail-internet-freedom (ERR)] [https://techcrunch.com/2018/07/04/wikipedia-goes-dark-in-spanish-italian-ahead-of-key-eu-vote-on-copyright/ (TechCrunch)] 
*[[1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal]]
**Former [[Malaysia]]n [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|Prime Minister]] [[Najib Razak]] is charged with abuse of power and three counts of criminal breach of trust. He pleads not guilty to all charges and accuses the government of seeking "political vengeance." [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/najib-razak-charged-in-court-1mdb-10497402 (Channel NewsAsia)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna888801 (NBC News)]
